title: Juicy Crispy Saudi Arabian Lamb Skillet
description: A tangy and crispy one-pot Saudi Arabian dish featuring pomegranate molasses, deep-fry-tod, and paleo-friendly ingredients, served in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large dolsot stone bowl over medium high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pomegranate molasses, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Increase the heat to medium high and cook, uncovered, for an additional 5 minutes, or until the lamb is crispy and caramelized.
Serve the lamb skillet hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
